resources.string: A few quick steps so every dose reaches you on time.
Allow notifications so reminders can reach you.
Allow alarms and reminders so doses ring on time, even in battery saver.
Allow full-screen alarms so a missed dose can wake the screen.
Turn off battery restrictions for Medicine Reminder so your phone does not stop reminders.
More help for your phone model

string-array.name: oem_xiaomi_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Apps, then Manage apps, then Medicine Reminder.
Under Battery saver, choose No restrictions.
Open recent apps, pull down on the Medicine Reminder card and tap the lock icon.

string-array.name: oem_realme_oppo_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Medicine Reminder, and allow background activity.
Open Settings, then App management, then Medicine Reminder, and turn on Auto launch.
Lock the app in recent apps if your phone offers it.

string-array.name: oem_vivo_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Background power consumption, and allow Medicine Reminder.
Turn on Autostart for Medicine Reminder.

string-array.name: oem_oneplus_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Battery optimisation, and choose Don\'t optimise for Medicine Reminder.
Allow Auto launch for Medicine Reminder.
Lock the app in recent apps.

string-array.name: oem_samsung_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Background usage limits.
Remove Medicine Reminder from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps.
Set battery usage for Medicine Reminder to Unrestricted.

string-array.name: oem_huawei_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then App launch, and set Medicine Reminder to Manage manually.
Allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

string-array.name: oem_other_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Apps, then Medicine Reminder, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted.
Lock the app in recent apps if your phone offers it.

resources.string: Medicine Reminder is a reminder aid, not medical advice. Follow your doctor\'s or pharmacist\'s instructions, and do not double a missed dose without asking them.
Your data stays on this phone.
Notifications or alarms are turned off for this app.
